title: Cubic work bound for the learner
statement: For nonnegative integers $n,\ell$, a rational parameter $\delta$ with $0<\delta\le 1/2$, and any labeled sample sequence of the scheduled sample count, the low degree polynomial learner's work is at most $3K^3$, where $K=2^\ell\bigl((\ell+1)(n+1)^\ell+b(\delta)+2\bigr)$ and $b(\delta)=\lceil\log_2\lceil2/\delta\rceil\rceil$.
hypotheses_covered: the sample sequence has length equal to the scheduled sample count
